title: Tender247DailyScreeningEmail
description: Payload posted by tender-automation to Power Automate after screening + Supabase upsert (and on failure / count mismatch). Subject and body are always dynamic per run.

subject.description: Dynamic email subject, e.g. [Tender247] Screening complete — 2026-08-26 (16 tenders)

body.description: Dynamic inline-styled HTML email body (Outlook-safe tables) with counts, project chips, web vs Excel check, errors
